# Offline spelling resources

JetVideo reads the Russian and Ukrainian Hunspell dictionaries as separate data files. The dictionary and affix files are the unmodified source files from [LibreOffice dictionaries revision 79195b017e](https://github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/tree/79195b017e6d70151337856c59e7d13d311d6630).

| Resource | License or upstream notice |
| --- | --- |
| Alexander I. Lebedev's Russian dictionary | [Upstream copyright notice and redistribution terms](ru_RU/README_ru_RU.txt) |
| Ukrainian dictionary prepared by Andriy Rysin | [Upstream notice](uk_UA/README_uk_UA.txt) and [Mozilla Public License 1.1](uk_UA/MPL-1.1.txt) |
| Spylls 0.1.7 | [Mozilla Public License 2.0 supplied with the package](LICENSE-spylls-MPL-2.0.txt) |

The exact Spylls [source distribution](https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/5c/c2/19f34deb2dc1475dfeadafbd5666246041ee7578bb933e82de794f0a9283/spylls-0.1.7.tar.gz) has SHA-256 `7045892dcbd324d3685f69c5a760063e78fb839913724ce18077cf0a0c93f220`. The [Python wheel](https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/cd/19/ce6fcb4b86e188983bcfc1f84e4ac6f3038ca8d68b6d70a678cdc566f66c/spylls-0.1.7-py2.py3-none-any.whl) has SHA-256 `0c7fa4b66615f390bd12fd37939b85934c012309fd3cce8584844c54270b7776`.
